short_description: A curated collection of agent skills for Claude, Cursor, Hyper, and beyond.

sections.overview:
agentfx-skills is a curated collection of agent skills designed to extend the capabilities of Claude, Cursor, Hyper, and other AI agents. Created and maintained by hyperfx-ai, this automation skill set provides pre-built functionalities that developers can integrate into their AI agent workflows. The collection focuses on practical agent extensions that enable more sophisticated automation tasks across multiple platforms.
Extending Claude's capabilities with pre-built automation skills
Enhancing Cursor with agent functionalities for development workflows
Adding specialized skills to Hyper agents for custom automation
Building multi-agent systems with standardized skill components
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/hyperfx-ai/agentfx-skills`
